name: ppt-element-decompose
description: Element decomposition target schema for PPT background/material/text/icon separation.

layers.description: Full-slide background, texture, atmosphere, color fields. Must reserve text-safe areas.
Product photos, source images, foreground cutouts, charts or maps from user materials.
Editable title, subtitle, bullets, data points, speaker notes. Never flatten into background.
Icons, dividers, small accents, badges, page numbers, decorative marks.

policy: PPTX text is authoritative and should be parsed from the PPTX whenever possible.
Visual segmentation is only a fallback for flattened images/screenshots.
Generated decomposition should preserve aspect ratio and never stretch materials.
